title: Extremely low birth weight infants <500 g: analysis of mortality and short- and long-term morbidity
summary: This study investigates extremely low birth weight infants (<500 g). It analyzes their chances of survival and typical complications during and after treatment. The data were collected as part of routine clinical care at two specialized perinatal centers in Germany. The results aim to improve medical treatment and support better counseling for parents.
conditions: Newborn: birth weight less than 500 grams
